question: What arises from eagerness to manifest māyā for those with its impressions?
premises: Eagerness to manifest māyā causes result.
Those with its impressions are affected.
Various counsel is full of many action-beginnings.
inference: From eagerness to manifest māyā, those with its impressions receive various counsel full of many action-beginnings.
uncertainties: mantraṇam may mean counsel or mantra-rite.
plain_english: From eagerness to manifest māyā, those enjoying its impressions thus receive various counsel full of many action-beginnings.
